subjects.displayTitle: Power of prayer: communion, courage and action
subjects.introduction: The weak turn to the Strong and the seeker of bounty to the Bountiful: that, ‘Abdu’l-Bahá says, is reason enough to pray even though God already knows every need, because the asking itself becomes a light to the heart of the one who asks. Something begins to change in that person: a heart polished like a mirror, a will laid down, a day steadied by a midnight conversation with God. This is a power that works less on circumstances than on people. It excuses no one from the hand of practical means; the medicine is still taken, the child still taught, and a decision reached in prayer still calls for tireless effort. Nor does it promise every outcome, for some decrees can be averted and some cannot, and a believer may pray for healing and still have to give back what was only ever lent. The road runs on toward the state of prayer and its inner dynamics, toward the obligatory prayer that gives devotion a daily shape, and toward the spiritual transformation of the one who keeps conversing with God.

By spiritual circumambulation is meant heart attachment, inner attraction, expansion of breasts, revival of spirit, and the enkindling of the fire of the love of God.

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: We hope that through the favors of the Self-Subsisting, Living Lord, the effects of the blessings of this proxy pilgrimage will become manifest.

shortened: O Mustafa! Say: Praise be unto Thee, O my Lord, the Most Glorious, for having caused me to hear Thy call and making me present before the throne of Thy grandeur, and for having conversed with me without veil or barrier.

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: O my Lord! I am he who has sought Thy nearness and Thy presence, to stand before Thy throne and at the door of Thy grandeur. Wouldst Thou turn away from Thy door him who hopes in Thee, or disappoint him in what he seeks from the wonders of Thy grace and favors?

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: These melodies shall reach unto the Kingdom of Glory, and these songs shall cheer and gladden the Concourse on high.

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: Every longing one whose eyes had turned white from grief of separation regained sight through the fragrance of Thy garment, and every ailing seeker became whole and well, and every deaf seeker became hearing, and every thirsty one became quenched, and every hungry one became satisfied.

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: When the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is completed, when the lights are emanating therefrom, and the righteous assemble therein, when prayers are offered to the Kingdom of divine mysteries and the voice of glorification is raised to the Supreme Lord, then shall the believers rejoice, and their hearts be dilated, overflowing with the love of the ever-living and self-subsisting God.

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: And, for the tranquility and repose of the hearts, there is no other means save the commemoration of almighty God.

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: When its accessories are completed and its full machinery starts running, when the melody of vocal and instrumental music arises and bursts upon the air with its joyous trends, when the prayers and supplications addressed at dawn and at sunrise ascend to the Throne of the Almighty, then will the effect of the Mashrekol-Azkar be made evident and manifest.

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: Console and show great love on my behalf to the maidservant of God thy daughter, Ella Rice-Wray, and say, "The meeting of worship that thou didst establish will undoubtedly bring important results. It will become the cause of promotion of the Cause of God and the motive of firmness and steadfastness, unity and concord."

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: Raise thou such melodies and harmony in Green Acre that may reach unto the Kingdom of ABHA and cause joy and exaltation in the angels of heaven!

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: We visit the Holy Shrine at all times on your behalf and implore the outpourings of the Abha Kingdom that, God willing, you may be so successful in serving God's Cause and unifying the Word that the voice of praise from the invisible Realm and the Concourse on High may reach the ears of all these yearning souls.

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: They who turned toward the throne after My arrival in the Most Great Prison - the Concourse on High pray for them and perceive from them the sweet fragrances of the mercy of their Lord, the All-Merciful.

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: Today in the world of existence no love and kindness can be conceived of greater than this: that a soul should, in the Blessed Garden, engage in the mention and remembrance of a friend and offer prayers for good. This is His most great favor, His greatest gift, His most perfect bestowal and His most exalted bounty.

order.why: Follow longing for presence through practical travel limits, proxy visits, community gatherings and service; retain named historical settings.
shortened: When I reach the Shrine of Baha'u'llah, I shall lay my head on the Sacred Threshold and beseech confirmation for every one of the friends.

If the friends were to act, or had acted, according to that which was revealed, the whole world would guard them as the pupils of their eyes, and the hosts of the unseen would protect them from behind. All things have been and are among the hosts of God. The winds are reckoned among His troops, the mountains among His armies. Moses with but a staff threw the world into turmoil, for it appeared through God's command and arose to serve Him.

I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name and Thy dominion that overshadoweth the world, to assist me to be steadfast in Thy love and to number me with those who have attained unto Thy good-pleasure. Verily, Thou art the Omnipotent over whatsoever Thou willest.

order.why: Place courage and severe imagery within persecution, nonretaliation and historical reports; preserve the original accounts without turning anecdotes into instructions.
shortened: I swear by the Sun of Truth that the sighs of the oppressed are more potent in their effect than cannons and sharper than swords! Though consummate wisdom may require that some fruits of deeds be delayed for a limited time, such delay will not prevent the inevitable decree. Assuredly the oppressors have been and will be requited.

shortened: By the hand of power He lit a lamp, and the contrary winds which are the cause of its extinction, by His all-compelling will, served but to increase its radiance. A fire that the hand of power kindleth, the seas of the world cannot extinguish.

shortened: O young one! Call upon your Lord, for We hear what you supplicate to your Creator. He will answer you and every destitute one who has become poor before his Lord, and every one who is denied and deprived.

order.why: Place courage and severe imagery within persecution, nonretaliation and historical reports; preserve the original accounts without turning anecdotes into instructions.
shortened: In the middle of the night at dawn I supplicate and implore at the threshold of the All-Knowing God and beg for aid, grace and boundless bounty.

order.why: Place courage and severe imagery within persecution, nonretaliation and historical reports; preserve the original accounts without turning anecdotes into instructions.
shortened: At the time of the dominion, might and power of the enemies, prayers were openly offered. Now, praise be to God, through divine assistance and favor they are victorious and triumphant.

order.why: Place courage and severe imagery within persecution, nonretaliation and historical reports; preserve the original accounts without turning anecdotes into instructions.
shortened: Therefore pray that God may confirm and grant a glance of favor - the God who can make black earth a place of heart's delight, who can make desolate land into a rose garden, who with a single attention can transform Iran and give order to scattered souls, make the ruined prosperous, and make sorrowful hearts joyful and delighted.

shortened: Read always the supplications. Turn always thy attention toward God. Be always stirred with divine Fragrances; then eternal happiness will be thy share.

Herein lieth the power of God, that a single drop endureth an ocean of tribulation.

shortened: Say: It behoveth every true believer to assist his Lord. He, verily, is your helper, while the people have no one to turn to in this Day.

shortened: Should adversity touch thee, seek the aid of My Name, the Helper, the Assisting, the All-Powerful, and through it God will dispel the affliction of those who have believed and are among the steadfast.

order.why: Place courage and severe imagery within persecution, nonretaliation and historical reports; preserve the original accounts without turning anecdotes into instructions.
shortened: Send down therefore, O my God, upon them that which will make them mighty through Thy power and exalted through Thy sovereignty, that the oppression of the oppressors may not hold them back from Thy path, nor the clamor of the idolaters prevent them from turning toward the court of Thy oneness.

order.why: Place courage and severe imagery within persecution, nonretaliation and historical reports; preserve the original accounts without turning anecdotes into instructions.
shortened: Therefore I beseech Thee, O my most glorious God, by Thy Self which Thou hast cast into the Most Great Prison for the liberation of mankind, that Thou assist Thy loved ones at all times through Thy wondrous confirmations and mighty inspirations, that they may all arise to aid Thy Cause and spread Thy remembrance, and that they may all become detached from all else save Thee and turn to none other than Thee, O our Lord, the All-Merciful, and O our Beloved, the Help in Peril!

order.why: Place courage and severe imagery within persecution, nonretaliation and historical reports; preserve the original accounts without turning anecdotes into instructions.
shortened: Though under the sword, We make mention of the servants with that which shall profit them and draw them nigh unto God, the Mighty, the Peerless.

order.why: Place courage and severe imagery within persecution, nonretaliation and historical reports; preserve the original accounts without turning anecdotes into instructions.
shortened: O friends! Arise with utmost steadfastness in the Cause of the Beloved of the worlds, in such wise that the entire world may testify to this most great station. The degrees of steadfastness, detachment, firmness and constancy become apparent only at the time when the clamor of the barking ones, the ungodly and the atheists is raised.

order.why: Place courage and severe imagery within persecution, nonretaliation and historical reports; preserve the original accounts without turning anecdotes into instructions.
shortened: Instead I will pray fervently and in the hours of dawn will, with utmost ardour and humility, implore tearfully to the Abha Kingdom, beseeching unbounded protection and help for all of you. Divine confirmation will undoubtedly be forthcoming.

shortened: Nevertheless, night and day supplications and entreaties are raised to the threshold of Oneness that each of the loved ones may become like a brilliant lamp, a radiant star, a shining orb, and a clear sign, and that the outpourings of the Most Glorious Kingdom may arrive successively one after another.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: Rather these are breezes that shall never be cut off from pure and holy hearts, for they waft from the direction of the garment of the Beloved and pass from the Most Great Prison which is the seat of the throne of the All-Merciful. Blessed is he who hath found and known! Blessed is he who hath inhaled and breathed in! Blessed is he who hath turned toward Him with his breast stripped bare of coverings! And blessed is he who hath turned wholly unto Him, sanctified from all directions!

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: We beseech God to assist you in your current endeavors and aid you in that which He loveth and is pleased with. Verily, He is the Protector of the sincere ones and the Answerer of the prayers of the supplicants.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: Several years ago this blessed verse was revealed from the Kingdom of Utterance - exalted and mighty be His Word: "This is not the day for questions. It behoveth every soul, when he heareth the Call, to say: 'Here am I, here am I, O Lord of Names!' and 'Here am I, here am I, O Desire of the worlds!'"

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: Praise be to God, the Pen of Response is in motion and each question hath been granted an explicit answer. Verily our Lord and your Lord, and our Beloved and your Beloved, is powerful over all things and worthy to respond.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: O people of God! Aid your Lord, the All-Merciful, through wisdom and utterance, and through the hosts of goodly deeds and character, that the fragrance of His good-pleasure may be diffused therefrom.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: The petition of that beloved of the heart hath in truth produced a mighty effect, and evident fruits have appeared therefrom. The passage of time shall not alter these fruits, nor change their freshness.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: Remember God in the night season and in the days in such wise that the hearts of the heedless may be attracted.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: Hadst thou been present at the time of its revelation, the attraction of revelation would have seized thee in such wise that thou wouldst have found thyself soaring to a station at which eyes are dazzled.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: O Muhammad! We have heard thy call, and the cry of thy heart, and the yearning of thy soul in thy love for thy Lord, unto Whom is thy return and thy final abode. The servant who is present hath come and read what thou hast spoken and called out and whispered and praised - the One Who is the Goal of all who are in the heavens and on earth.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: Verily He answereth whosoever calleth upon Him and turneth unto whosoever hath turned unto Him. He, verily, is the Near One, the Watchful.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: This has resulted from the many preoccupations of heart and body; otherwise, at all times when we attain the presence of and are honored at the Holy Shrine, we are occupied with your remembrance and thought, beseeching and supplicating from the manifest bounty of the Ancient Beauty that at all times He may perfume your pure and goodly nostrils with the holy fragrances of the Abha Kingdom, and day by day increase the heat and enkindlement of that divine Samandar of the fire of God's love.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: I swear by the Greatest Name that remembrance of the friends brings comfort to the soul and joy to the conscience, and brings such spirit and fragrance that the heart comes into rapture and delight and the soul into longing and ecstasy.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: According to thy wish, I prayed and implored at the Threshold of Oneness and asked for thee this great Blessing and these Illustrious Bounties.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: Whatever supplications have been made in the hidden mysteries and secrets at the threshold of the Blessed Beauty, there is hope through His glorious bounty that they have been answered.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: O thou exalted branch of the Divine Lote Tree! Night and day, morning and evening, even in the darkness of night and middle of day, I supplicate and beseech with utmost humility at the threshold of the Divine Unity, saying: "O God! These souls are Afnans of the Tree of Thy mercy and branches of the Tree of Thy oneness.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: To continue:  Your letter reached Me, and when I had read and learned of its contents, I repaired to the station and laid it before the face of our Lord, the Mighty, the All-Knowing. Thereupon the Tongue of Grandeur spoke that which diffused the fragrance of the All-Merciful throughout all creation.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: We beseech God to assist thee in all conditions. This prayer hath already been answered.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: Wert thou to gather all that hath been revealed for thee, thou wouldst find it a book wherein every word indicateth thy Lord's loving care.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: And thou, O servant, know that thy letter came before Us and God's gaze turned toward it out of love for thee, and He was ever watchful over thee.

Blessed art thou for having opened the doors of thy heart in thy recognition of God and for having turned thee to a seat of mighty glory and raised thee to a station where thou didst hear the melody of grandeur from the mouth of Glory and where He gave thee to drink of the sweetest nectar from holy and impregnable chalices.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: We beseech God that through thy remembrance and supplication He may raise up servants in the earth. Verily He is the Powerful, the Mighty.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: O Karim! Your call reached the threshold of the Throne of the Merciful, and the divine sacred ear inclined to hear it.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: O thou who soarest in the atmosphere of the Intended One! We have been with thee in all conditions and heard what thou didst call upon God, thy Lord and the Lord of all worlds.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: We have heard thy call and have answered thee with that which shall endure as long as the Kingdom of God, the Lord of Lords, shall endure.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: Concerning your mention of Mulla Hasan---upon him be the glory of Baha'u'llah---and the state in which he found himself after being vouchsafed the honour of attaining unto that most august and all-protecting Tablet of the Most Holy, Divine Presence: well is it with him, and with whosoever hath discovered the fragrance of the loving-kindness of the All-Merciful in His utterance. God Himself beareth witness and is the surety thereof, that were all who dwell upon the earth to catch but the faintest breath of a single word from among the Words of God, they would, one and all, become drunken with its rapture, and would turn, illumined, unto the lights of His Countenance.

order.why: Read correspondence as relationship: the occasion, the intermediary and the named recipient matter to the assurance being offered.
shortened: Shouldst thou ask for all who are on earth, We would surely fulfill thy need and would send down from the heaven of My generosity, for each one of them, the signs of My grandeur and My clear tokens.

My God, my God! Separation from Thee hath destroyed me, remoteness from Thee hath consumed me, Thy Manifestation hath bewildered me, Thy verses have enkindled me, and Thy clear signs have attracted me.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: By God! Were all things to hear but one note of His melodies with the ear of their inmost nature, they would surely be drawn unto the court of glorified might.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: And were my flesh to be boiled in the cauldron of hate, the smell which it would send forth would rise towards Thee and cry out: "Where art Thou, O Lord of the worlds, Thou One Desire of them that have known Thee!"

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: I implore Thee, O my God, by the Lights of Thy unity and the Repositories of Thy revelation, to send down from the clouds of Thy mercy that which will cleanse the hearts of all such as have turned towards Thee.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: I implore Thee, by Thy Most Great Name, and Thy most ancient sovereignty, to look upon Thy loved ones whose hearts have been sorely shaken by reason of the troubles that have touched Him Who is the Manifestation of Thine own Self.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: When thou findest the fragrance of the All-Merciful's utterance and art attracted by the breezes of revelation, say:
My God, my God! Thou seest me advancing toward Thee, standing before the door of Thy grandeur, and gazing toward the horizon of Thy grace.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: Say: O people! Nothing shall profit you this day though ye should cling to all things between earth and heaven, or remember God throughout the duration of His kingdom. Thus hath the command been sent down from the presence of One mighty and wise.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: I render Thee thanks, therefore, and extol Thee, in the name of all them that are dear to Thee, for that Thou hast caused them to be born again, by reason of the living waters which have flowed down out of the mouth of Thy will.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! Thou seest me turning toward Thee, detached from all else but Thee. I beseech Thee by the Word through which Thou didst manifest from nothingness the Sign of eternity, to ordain for me that which will benefit me in every world of Thy worlds.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: It is said by Christ (Glory be to Him!) "Pray that ye may not enter into temptation." Now, it is incumbent upon thee to pray! It is incumbent upon thee to beseech God!

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: It is evident that when a breath is released for the sake of God from the human world, it influences the pillars of existence, both seen and unseen, and creates a warmth in the world of hearts that the sea of contingent being cannot extinguish.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: Make the withered earth verdant and flourishing, and breathe new life into the frozen heart, so that in utter helplessness it may find heavenly power, and in complete poverty it may seek eternal wealth.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: O maid-servant of God! Forget all else save God, be in communion with Him, supplicate and pray to Him to make thee conqueror over the material things, impressed by the bounties of the Kingdom, commemorating the name of thy Lord, pure from all else save Him, and imbued with the spiritual attributes of those who are holy (and high); then shall thy breaths have effect upon the hearts, and attract the hearts of thy son and husband unto the Kingdom of God.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: Become a sign of remembrance, and occupy thyself night and day with humble devotions and supplications. Show forth utter neediness and helplessness, and become an intimate companion in prayer.

shortened: Thanks be to the bounties of the Most Glorious Kingdom that has cast such love and affection and connection and unity into hearts, that when 'Abdu'l-Baha utters the names of the beloved ones, darkness becomes light and gloom is transformed into joy.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: O thou handmaid, faithful and believing!

The hearts of all the friends rejoiced, and in particular, the heart of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, when we heard of thy rising up to serve the Cause of God, and that thou hast set apart one of the rooms in thy home for meetings of the lovers of God, so that from it may ascend to the Lord of Revelation the clamour of chanted prayers.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: How often, O my God, has he communed with You in the darkness of nights, seeking refuge at the gate of Your oneness and assistance through Your might and power, that You may aid him in serving Your Cause and make him successful in raising the banners of Your Word, in pointing to You, in guiding to You, and in bearing witness before You.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: If thou seekest an intimate companion for thy soul, become the companion of His remembrance, and if thou desirest the expanses of Paradise and consciousness, make the heart a wellspring of recognition and dawning-place of the star of certitude.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: That you expressed insufficiency is evidence of your increased seeking from the treasury of grace. Yea, those who seek the Ka'bah of the All-Merciful and circle round the sanctuary of the All-Glorious are like fish in the ocean--the more they drink, the more they cry out "Is there more?"

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: Say:

My God, my God, my Lord, my Support, my Goal, my Object of worship, and the Ultimate End of my desire! By Thy might and majesty, Thy greatness and power, I long to lay my face upon every spot of Thy earth that perchance it may be honored by having been touched by the feet of Thy loved ones.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: Thy might beareth me witness! Every limb of my body crieth out to Thee and saith: "O Thou Who art the Well-Beloved of the worlds, and the Lord of all that are in heaven and on earth, and the one Desire of the hearts which are devoted to Thee!

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: At every moment I commune in prayer and supplication at the Threshold of the Ancient Beauty, so that moment by moment from the cloud of providence dewdrops may fall upon the gardens of hearts, making them verdant and adorned with flowers and sweet herbs.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: Make the insignificant ant a Solomon of the glorious realm and make the poor atom a prince of the zenith of ether. Bestow upon the drop the bounty of the sea and grant the blade of grass the freshness and delicacy of the green tree.

order.why: Give space to longing and grief, then to companionship and the desire to serve; keep distinct speakers and personal addresses visible.
shortened: He whom the grace of Thy mercy aideth, though he be but a drop, shall become the boundless ocean, and the merest atom which the outpouring of Thy loving-kindness assisteth, shall shine even as the radiant star.

shortened: Verily Thy lovers thirst, O my Lord; lead them to the wellspring of bounty and grace. Verily, they hunger; send down unto them Thy heavenly table. Verily, they are naked; robe them in the garments of learning and knowledge.

Thou seest Thy servant turning toward the horizon of Thy prison. I beseech Thee by the light of Thy Cause, whereby Thy earth and heaven were illumined, to aid me to serve Thy loved ones.

shortened: By God! Through His remembrance are quickened the hearts of them that have known Him, and through it are severed from all that hath been created between the heavens and earth the souls of those whom the overpowering raptures of longing have seized.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: I implore Thee by the mysteries of Thy Book and the sweetness of Thy utterance to ordain for me the reward of those who were steadfast in Thy Cause and who spoke Thy praise in such wise that the hosts of those who denied Thee and Thy signs could not hinder them.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: O my Lord! I am he who hath turned toward the ocean of Thy grace and acknowledged Thy sovereignty and power. I beseech Thee to aid me in all conditions to serve Thee and remember Thee and praise Thee. Verily Thou art the Protector of those in earth and heaven. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: O my Lord! Thou seest me turning toward the lights of Thy countenance and awaiting the wonders of Thy grace. I beseech Thee not to disappoint me of that which Thou hast ordained for such of Thy servants as are sincere, whom neither swords could deter from clinging to equity in Thy Cause, nor could the hosts of the wicked frighten from turning toward the sanctuary of Thy nearness.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: O honored pilgrim, memorize this prayer and recite it at the threshold of the All-Merciful during times of joy and fragrance.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: O Lord! Make bright his morn, illumine his lamp, loose his tongue, make manifest his exposition, and make him a sign of Thy great mercy. Verily, Thou art the Hearer of Prayer, and verily, Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful.

order.why: Keep natural means—the sun and water—beside the appeal to divine grace.
shortened: Water and sun are Thy two great signs - deprive not Thy servants of these two. By Thy leave they are effective, and without it they neither nourish nor satisfy, and thus shall it ever be. Thy power maketh dust to become as the sun and earth to become as heaven. Take our hands, for we are helpless. Bestow Thy grace, for we are poor and lowly.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: When thou hast attained the choice wine of My utterance and found the fragrance of My verses, say: My God, my God! Aid me to remember Thee and praise Thee and serve Thy Cause, that I may arise among Thy servants to exalt Thy Word and manifest Thy Cause until the standards of Thy oneness and the banners of Thy victory are raised.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: Glory be to Thee, O God of Paradise and the Garden, and Educator of all creation! I beseech Thee by the manifestations of Thy sovereignty and the modes of Thy Self-Subsistence to preserve those who have turned to Thee from the evil of self and passion, and aid them in that which diffuseth the fragrance of Thy good-pleasure.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the lights that shine forth from the dayspring of Thy mercy and the stars in the heaven of Thy grace, to aid Thy servants to rend asunder that which hath prevented them from turning towards Thee and from attaining unto Thy presence.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: When thou hast attained unto My verses and been seized by the wine of the choice nectar of My utterance, say: My God, my God! Thy call hath drawn me near, and Thy nearness is my hope and desire, and Thy separation hath consumed me, and Thy remoteness hath destroyed me. I beseech Thee by the mysteries of Thy Kingdom and the signs of Thy Dominion, and by the Point through which Thy Books and Thy Scriptures were differentiated, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause, speaking forth Thy praise, and holding fast to Thy Covenant and Testament.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: When thou hast attained unto the traces of My Most Exalted Pen and art attracted by the breezes of revelation, turn thy face toward the House and say:
My God, my God! Thy call hath drawn me near, and Thy grace hath confirmed me, and the light of Thy manifestation hath guided me to Thy straight path and Thy mighty announcement.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: Say:

Glorified art Thou, O my God! Unto Thee be praise for having guided me, taught me, caused me to know Thee, and fed me from the table of recognition, and given me to drink from the Kawthar of utterance. My Lord! I beseech Thee by Thyself and by Thy most great signs to assist me in that which Thou hast commanded me in Thy Book.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: Thou art He Who hath opened the door of hope unto all who are in earth and heaven and ordained for Thy servants and Thy handmaidens that which draweth them nigh unto Thee.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: O my Lord! Thou seest that he hath turned toward Thee and appeared before Thy face, and the might of the wicked ones hath not deterred him.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: Then enable me, O my God, to aid Thy Cause and assist Thy Faith, that I may sacrifice my spirit, my soul and my body before Thy Beauty and in beholding the lights of the glory of Thine eternity.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: Do Thou ordain for him through Thy Most Exalted Pen that which shall draw him nigh unto the Most Sublime Summit. Thou, verily, art the Educator of the world and the Lord of the nations, and Thou, verily, art the Potent, the All-Subduing, the Almighty.

order.why: Let complete prayers carry the movement from longing and acknowledgment of limits to steadfastness and useful action.
shortened: O my God! They have bowed down to the Word of Thy transcendent Unity and prostrated themselves on the ground in exaltation before the majesty of Thy Oneness, and fell on dust in submission and humility to Thy Divine Threshold. O God! Accept from them every good deed in Thy path, Thou art the Benevolent.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: I swear by the Sun of Utterance, there hath been ordained for thee that which the bird of imagination is powerless and incapable of attaining. Thou hast attained unto the blessing of recognition and received thy portion from the table of utterance, and thou hast been assisted to turn towards and act in the path of God, the Lord of the worlds.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Thereby hath the orb of "He doeth what He willeth" shone forth from the horizon of the Cause. Give thanks unto God for that He hath removed the veil from before thine eyes and revealed that which had been hidden from all vision. When thou findest the fragrance of the Bayan, say: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, the All-Merciful, by the lights of Thy Face and by the pinions that have flown in the air of Thy love, that Thou mayest ordain for me, from the Pen of Thy Command, that which will confirm me in all conditions.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by the tears of Thy sincere servants and the sighs of Thy near ones, and by the pearls of the ocean of Thy knowledge and the movement of Thy Most Exalted Pen and the rustling of the Lote Tree of the furthermost boundary, to aid me to serve Thy Cause and to be steadfast in Thy love.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: By the Sun of the Kingdom of utterance! If the shrill voice of the Supreme Pen were truly heard by an attentive ear, all people would leave their homes and cry out "Here am I, O God, here am I!"

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Verily, through the call of God are drawn the hearts of the pure ones, and were all who are in the heavens and earth to hear it, they would detach themselves from all things and turn toward the precincts of the Throne, the seat whereon thy Lord, the Most Merciful, the Compassionate, is established.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: This call quickens the body and brings the soul to its Beloved. O Husayn! Listen with thy heart's ear, that thou mayest attain, through the sweetness of the divine Word, to such a station that thou wilt find thyself, at all times, in a state of joy and delight.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Blessed be thy tongue for having attained to the remembrance of God, the Lord of the kingdom of earth and heaven, and blessed be thine ear for having hearkened unto His call when it was raised from the realm of might, and happy be thy heart for having turned and thy face for having been directed.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Blessed is the pen that hath moved in My remembrance, and the face that hath turned toward My court, and the heart that hath turned to My horizon, and the ear that hath heard the Call when it was raised betwixt earth and heaven, and the hand that hath taken hold of My perspicuous Book.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Beseech God that thou mayest taste the sweetness of His utterance, for whoever hath found it hath seen himself detached from the world and all that is therein.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Not an atom's weight escapeth His knowledge, and with Him is the knowledge of the heavens and earths. Remember thy Lord throughout all days and be not veiled from Him. Indeed His remembrance is better than whatsoever hath been created in the realm of existence, wert thou of them that know. Through His remembrance souls find peace and the hearts of them that remember are gladdened.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Glorify thy Lord with praise in the morning and the evening, at sunset and at dawn. Thus doth the Wronged One command thee from this remote spot.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: A prayer was sent before; persevere in it, for it is a key to the gates of divine favor and mercy and kindness.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Blessed art thou, O thou who gazest upon what has been sent down to thee in this Tablet, by which spirits take flight. Preserve it, then recite it. By My life! It is a gate to thy Lord's mercy. Blessed is he who recites it at eventide and at dawn.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: O servant of God! Say: The Lord declareth: He that is afflicted seeketh not wellness and shall not arise, and he that beareth the sign shall not attain unto salvation.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: O ‘Alí! Remembrance of Me is a healing medicine to the souls and a light to the hearts of men.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Through the influence of this chalice, do Thou revive O Lord, all the dwellers of the earth and ordain for the people of Baha -- they that yearn to behold Thy face but have been turned away by reason of what the hands of Thine enemies have wrought -- ordain for them that which will profit them, O Thou Who art the Lord of names and the Possessor of earth and heavens!

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Send down upon them, O my God, from the clouds of Thy mercy that which will cause to grow from their hearts the plants of Thy knowledge and wisdom.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: Let us pray to God that He will exhilarate our spirits so we may behold the descent of His bounties, illumine our eyes to witness His great guidance and attune our ears to enjoy the celestial melodies of the heavenly Word.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: O faithful servant of God, truly you have witnessed the power of the confirmations of the Most Great Name and observed the influence of the breathings of the Holy Spirit.

order.why: Explore recognition, hearing and renewal together, retaining the historical and theological setting of each assurance.
shortened: O heaven, rain down! O cloud, pour forth! O storm clouds, thunder and flash! O horizons, be fragrant! O breeze of God, blow! O Spirit of God, be stirred!"

order.why: Move from encouragement toward the humility and effort of service, allowing different letters to illuminate one another.

order.why: Move from encouragement toward the humility and effort of service, allowing different letters to illuminate one another.
shortened: Abdul-Baha, every night in the darkest hours, with tearful eyes beseeches divine aid and grace. Surely this heat and flame will influence the hearts of the friends and they will arise with the utmost strength and power to serve the Cause of God.

order.why: Move from encouragement toward the humility and effort of service, allowing different letters to illuminate one another.
shortened: The divine friends must supplicate and implore night and day, and beg confirmation from the Kingdom of the Lord for this dust-heap, for without His favors we are nothing, nothing at all. Whatever happens is through His confirmation.

order.why: Move from encouragement toward the humility and effort of service, allowing different letters to illuminate one another.

Today all - that is, the community of the All-Merciful - must implore with utmost humility and supplication the Self-Sufficient Lord for the victory of His manifest Faith, and beseech the All-Powerful One to extinguish the fire of the ungodly.

order.why: Move from encouragement toward the humility and effort of service, allowing different letters to illuminate one another.

Therefore, you should supplicate and pray for such friends as these and implore confirmations and assistance.

order.why: Move from encouragement toward the humility and effort of service, allowing different letters to illuminate one another.

order.why: Move from encouragement toward the humility and effort of service, allowing different letters to illuminate one another.
shortened: We beseech God to make you enkindled with the fire of His love and speaking His praise among His servants, such that through your call the call of the world will be raised up.

order.why: Move from encouragement toward the humility and effort of service, allowing different letters to illuminate one another.
shortened: He will assist you through a power that proceedeth from Him and ordain for you that which shall endure as long as His own kingdom shall endure, the Inaccessible, the Mighty.

shortened: Verily He remembereth him who remembereth Him, and answereth him who raiseth his hands in supplication toward His exalted heaven. Thy Lord is, in truth, the All-Hearing, the Answering.

order.why: Move from encouragement toward the humility and effort of service, allowing different letters to illuminate one another.
shortened: Whoso hath attained unto the Book of God and His Cause is assuredly among those drawn nigh. It behooveth him to beseech God at all times to make him steadfast in this momentous Cause.

shortened: By God! We have heard thy call in the nights and at dawn. Therefore have We preserved thee that thou mayest hear this Call both secretly and openly.

shortened: He who hath awakened at the call of his Lord and arisen to serve Him - upon him shall the denizens of the Supreme Paradise bestow their blessings, and this is a praiseworthy station.

shortened: O my handmaid! Hear My call, by which the souls of the pure ones are stirred, and then the realities of the holy ones, and by the call of God the hearts of the sincere ones are attracted.

shortened: Grieve not at anything. Remember thy Lord. Verily, He heareth the call of whosoever turneth unto Him. He is the Guardian of them that remember Him.

shortened: The angels and the Spirit pray for them by His leave. We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to aid them and assist them in a manner befitting their connection to His firm and mighty Cause.

questions: The opening asks why one should pray when God already knows every need. How do communion, gratitude, longing, recognition and action each offer a different way into that question?
What changes when the power of prayer is understood through qualities such as courage, kindness, insight or steadfastness? Which passages also resist reducing prayer solely to its observable effects?

How do the accounts of healing, material treatment, inevitable death and bereavement qualify one another? What might it mean to accompany someone in prayer while remaining open to an outcome neither person desires?

Many selections are replies to particular people, while others are revealed prayers, reported conversations or letters written on behalf of the Guardian. How do the speaker, source status and circumstances affect what you can responsibly draw from a passage?

Compare Matthew 6:5–15 and Qur’an 2:186 with these readings. How do sincerity, divine nearness, forgiveness and response shape the relationship between asking and living? Where do the texts retain distinct emphases?

Choose a prayer or counsel that could become an act of care, consultation or service. What would putting it into practice involve, and how might the connected subjects on the state of prayer, obligatory prayer or spiritual transformation deepen your inquiry?

references.label: 1 · Matthew 6:5–15 · Prayer beyond display
references.note: Read Matthew 6:5–15 in the King James Version. Jesus places prayer beyond public display and excessive words, while the prayer that follows embraces daily bread, forgiveness and deliverance. Compare this movement with the opening readings on joy rather than quantity, inward communion and the life that follows prayer. If God already knows what is needed, what might asking change in the person who prays? How does forgiveness connect a private act of devotion with relationships? Attend to each tradition’s own setting and forms: a shared concern for sincerity need not make their devotional practices interchangeable.
references.verified: Read all eleven verses of Matthew 6:5–15 in the King James Version on Bible Gateway. Verified private prayer, the rejection of vain repetition, divine knowledge of need, daily bread, forgiveness and deliverance.

references.label: 2 · Qur’an 2:186 · Nearness and response
references.note: Read Qur’an 2:186 with the Arabic and the displayed English rendering. The verse brings divine nearness and response to the caller together with the invitation to respond to God and believe, so that people may be guided. Compare this reciprocity with the collection’s letters of remembrance and its repeated requests for steadfastness, knowledge and service. What forms can a response take? How might the assurance of being heard coexist with uncertainty about a particular outcome? Read the surrounding passage as well, noticing the setting of fasting rather than detaching the verse from religious practice. The parallel invites attentive comparison without assuming that every account of prayer or revelation means the same thing.
